result.brief: 提出DIAL：通过rollout对齐与多步逆动力学监督改进潜空间世界模型的动力学学习，并用逆动力学头自回归生成动作序列初始化CEM规划，提升视觉控制与长时序表现。
result.reason: Latent world model with rollout alignment and inverse dynamics for goal-conditioned visual control planning; contributes to latent dynamics learning, though main contribution is planning/control.
